## What I changed

The business-day rule was already centralized in a single utility, `BusinessDay.onOrAfter(LocalDate)` (used by `Owner.@PrePersist`, `DailyOwnerLimitValidator`, and `BulkSignupWarningEvaluator`), so extending it there means every caller inherits holiday handling for free — no logic duplicated.

In `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/BusinessDay.java`:

- Added the fixed public-holiday set (`2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`).
- Replaced the weekend-only branch logic with a small loop that rolls the date forward one day at a time until it lands on a business day, plus a private `isBusinessDay` helper. The loop correctly handles chained cases (e.g. a holiday whose next day is a weekend, or two adjacent holidays like the `2026-12-25`/`2026-12-28` cluster).

The single responsibility of `BusinessDay` — "what is a business day, and roll to the next one" — is preserved; the holiday knowledge lives with the calendar rule rather than leaking into the entity or validators.
